# Config keys reference

> **In 30 seconds.** Every top-level key of `.harness.json`. Look up, don't read through. Source of
> truth: [`harness.example.json`](../../plugins/mango/config/harness.example.json) — if this page and it
> disagree, it wins. Start from `config/harness.minimal.json` for a first ticket.

| Key | Section | Example value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulebook_path` | Required | `"docs/ENGINEERING_RULES.md"` | May be a FILE or a DIRECTORY. If a directory, every consumer (reviewer/onboarder agents, grounding skills) reads all *.md inside it. Default to one file so the whole rule set always loads; point at a folder to split later. |
| `repos` | Required | array | Array of {name, root}: every repository a ticket may touch (supports multi-repo porting). |
| `test_command` | Required | `"REPLACE_ME (e.g. the single command that runs your test suite or a focused subset)"` | The command phases use to run the proving test and the BASELINE. doctor reports ❌ while it still reads REPLACE_ME. |
| `tracker` | Required | object | Ticket source. Writes (comments, transitions) go through cli, never an MCP; reads may use the optional read-only read_mcp. Or { "mode": "local" } for local mode: analysis reads <tickets_dir>/<KEY>.md, mango makes no tracker call, and finalise prints the tracker update for you to apply. Local mode is only ever declared, never inferred from a missing key. |
| `ticket_header_schema` | Required | object | Maps each ticket header to C (context/constraint), R (requirement), G (goal) or AC (acceptance criterion) for the requirements matrix. |
| `tickets_dir` | Recommended | `"docs/tickets"` | Directory of ticket spec files (default docs/tickets). In local mode, analysis reads <tickets_dir>/<KEY>.md and doctor requires the directory to exist. |
| `pr_host` | Recommended | `"REPLACE_ME (e.g. the host/command used to open a pull request)"` | The command finalise uses to open the pull request (for example the PR host's CLI). |
| `lessons_path` | Recommended | `"docs/LESSONS.md"` | Where finalise writes each ticket's durable lesson; the learning loop recalls claims from it. |
| `high_stakes_paths` | Recommended | `[]` | OPTIONAL array of globs the PROJECT declares high-stakes (default []). execute keeps implementation on the main loop (no implementer dispatch) when the approved change list touches a match; review ORs it with its existing high-stakes signals (security tag, auth / access control / data access / schema-migration per rulebook_path) when selecting reviewer-max. It only ever tightens — it never removes a built-in signal. doctor does not require it. |
| `context_file` | Advanced | `"CLAUDE.md"` | The host's ALWAYS-ON context file — the one the coding host auto-loads into every session. Default CLAUDE.md. Some hosts load AGENTS.md instead (a project may keep a CLAUDE.md that only imports it). init hoists the mango:standing-context POINTER block into THIS file and doctor checks THIS file, so on an AGENTS-first project set it to AGENTS.md. It is still a pointer, never a copy, and never holds a secret. |
| `standards_path` | Advanced | `"docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md"` | OPTIONAL coding-standards file that design and the reviewer read alongside rulebook_path. |
| `work_dir` | Advanced | `"docs/tickets"` | Directory for mango's per-ticket WORKING DOC (<KEY>.work.md) — the mutable state doc carrying all five phases. Kept SEPARATE from the ticket spec so the challenger's input can exclude it. Defaults to tickets_dir if unset. |
| `work_doc_mode` | Advanced | `"auto"` | Where the working doc lives: auto \| separate \| embed (default auto). A tracker-hosted ticket always gets a separate <work_dir>/<KEY>.work.md. When the ticket is itself a local file in the repo, auto/embed APPEND the working doc to that file below a raw-ticket separator line (one file, no duplicate); separate always writes a distinct file. The raw ticket portion stays above the separator either way, so the challenger payload can exclude the working doc. GUIDANCE: for a local-file ticket that is ALSO a committed scaffold stub (e.g. an epic child-ticket stub committed by breakdown), prefer separate — embedding the mutable working doc in a committed, tracked file leaves its edits as uncommitted changes to a TRACKED file, which is fragile to any stray subagent git-state op; a distinct <KEY>.work.md avoids that fragility. |
| `pr_checklist_path` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL path to a project-owned finalise checklist (e.g. a PR-template or definition-of-done file). If set, finalise walks each item and reports satisfied/not-satisfied/N-A with evidence before drafting the PR, surfacing any unmet item at the final gate. mango supplies the mechanism; the project supplies the content. Omit or null to disable. |
| `stuck_threshold` | Advanced | `3` | Circuit-breaker: after this many failed attempts against the SAME proving artifact / failing-test signature, execute and quick STOP and escalate to the user instead of retrying. The counter resets when the failing signature changes. Default 3. |
| `explore_fanout` | Advanced | `true` | Read-only explorer fan-out on the full tier (default true). Set false to disable investigation fan-out; the lite tier never fans out. |
| `track` | Advanced | `"backend"` | Which gate set(s) apply: backend \| frontend \| fullstack (default backend). ORTHOGONAL to TIER (TIER = process weight; track = which gates). backend behaves exactly as pre-0.7. frontend adds the falsifiable a11y/token rubric + the M1–M10 responsive/touch gates. fullstack applies both gate sets. When unset, mango may INFER the track from touched-file paths (k/N files under UI paths). A ticket may be track=frontend + TIER=lite. |
| `breakpoints` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL list of viewport widths (CSS px) the frontend responsive gates test against, e.g. [375, 768, 1280]. The 320 px reflow floor is a STANDARD, always tested when track includes frontend regardless of this list. When a declared width is a small viewport, the width-parametric gates (M2 no-h-scroll, M3 reflow) come into scope. Ignored on the backend track. |
| `design_doc_path` | Advanced | `"DESIGN.md"` | OPTIONAL path to the per-project DESIGN.md contract (default DESIGN.md at repo root). On the frontend track, design creates/updates it (palette/typography/spacing tokens, shell vs data-core split, the Responsive & touch choices) and the review rubric is scored AGAINST it. Breakpoint values, navigation pattern, and which regions collapse vs reflow live here — they are project CHOICES, never gated by mango. |
| `cost_tier` | Advanced | `"standard"` | Model-delegation dial: economy \| standard \| max (default standard). economy pushes more bulk retrieval to a Haiku worker and avoids Opus on review; max allows Opus on review for high-stakes diffs. Never demotes review/challenger to Haiku. See PRINCIPLES.md routing map. |
| `token_optimizer` | Advanced | object | Human-gated record (via /mango:budget) of which external token optimizers mango may assume are present. DESCRIPTIVE + human-gated, exactly like codify: mango DETECTS + INFORMS + records a human's choice — it NEVER installs an optimizer, never DEPENDS on one, and never lets one weaken a check/gate/critic. Safety axis: an optimizer is safe only if it removes representation redundancy (how output is phrased), never a check, a gate, a critic, or the evidence detail a critic relies on (path:line, measured values, diffs). rtk: expect\|off (default expect) — mango tolerates RTK rewriting Bash-command output into a compact form; it does not install RTK and DEGRADES CLEANLY when RTK is absent (nothing fails, no decision changes — only the saving is lost). headroom.output_shaper MUST stay false (it changes what the model writes / how hard it thinks → can weaken a critic). caveman.scope is HARD-PINNED to non-critic-only: Caveman-style output compression must NEVER be applied to reviewer/challenger/gate-blocking output, which must retain full evidence detail. Enabling any optimizer is a recorded provisional decision (ratified like codify), never a silent toggle. |
| `update_check_url` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL raw URL to the published marketplace manifest (e.g. the raw marketplace.json of the marketplace mango is published from). If set, /mango:version-check fetches it to compare the running version against the latest published version and PRINTS the host /plugin commands when a newer one exists. mango never updates or installs — plugin administration is the host's job. Leave unset/null to disable the check (no network call). |
| `branch_strategy` | Advanced | `"fix\|feat\|chore/<KEY>-<slug>"` | Branch naming pattern execute uses (default fix\|feat\|chore/<KEY>-<slug>). |
| `skill_gap_path` | Advanced | `"docs/SKILL_GAP_CANDIDATES.md"` | OPTIONAL project-owned note recording type-3 SKILL-GAP SIGNALS — a mango phase that demonstrably skipped a check it could have made. A SIGNAL for mango's maintainer only: nothing here ever edits a mango skill, and mango is changed only by its maintainer through a normal version. |
| `gotchas_path` | Advanced | `"docs/gotchas.md"` | OPTIONAL project-owned list of type-4 irreducible world-facts — a platform/environment fact no gate could pre-empt. |
| `drift_path` | Advanced | `"docs/DRIFT.md"` | OPTIONAL project-owned drift/exceptions list: type-6 ADJUDICATED NON-DEFECTS (a deviation examined and accepted, recorded so it is not re-litigated). Every entry carries an EXPIRY condition. Also the destination for codify's drift list. |
| `agent_brief_path` | Advanced | `"docs/AGENT_BRIEF.md"` | OPTIONAL project-owned PROCESS brief for agents working in this repo — the destination for a type-2 PROCESS heuristic and for a preventive process-lesson that fits neither type 2 nor type 3. A process claim must never be filed in the code rule book. This is a PROJECT file: it is NOT one of mango's own agents/*.md briefs, which no loop output may touch. |
| `real_corpus_path` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL path to (or name of) a REAL indexed repository this project accepts as its reality check — input the change's author did not write. design's per-AC verification plan records a fixture provenance of authored \| real-corpus \| n/a; only an INPUT-SHAPE-DEPENDENT AC (a heuristic, grouping, ranking, summary or classification — output judged 'sensible' rather than 'equal to X') needs more than authored fixtures, and every other AC reads n/a and costs nothing. Unset → design REPORTS the corpus is not configured and records the claim as a coverage-gap exclusion with a checkable expiry; it is never silently downgraded to a passing 'authored'. A fresh project with no corpus runs with zero extra steps. |
| `doc_size_budget` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL size ceiling in BYTES for the per-ticket working doc. PROJECT-supplied — mango has no ceiling of its own. When set, scripts/check_lines.py reports the margin on its `doc` line and warns from 80% so the ceiling is surfaced BEFORE it bites rather than discovered after. It NEVER blocks: the budget is the project's rule, not a mango gate. Unset → no margin is reported and nothing changes. |
| `docs_dir` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL directory where the opt-in descriptive adapters write their regenerable maps (sitemap.md, db-map.md). Descriptive facts only — never normative rules. Unset → the adapters have nowhere to write and report they are not configured. |
| `code_map_cmd` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL command for /mango:sitemap to emit the code surface (routes/endpoints + modules). Opt-in & stack-specific; unset → sitemap reports it is not configured and does nothing. |
| `db_kind` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL database kind (generic label, e.g. relational/document). Required, with one of db_introspect_cmd or migrations_path, to enable /mango:db-map. db-map is OFF by default. |
| `db_introspect_cmd` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL read-only introspection command for /mango:db-map to derive the schema map. Must never alter or migrate the schema. Use this OR migrations_path. |
| `migrations_path` | Advanced | `null` | OPTIONAL directory of migration files for /mango:db-map to derive the schema from when no live introspection command is available. Use this OR db_introspect_cmd. |
| `specs_dir` | Advanced | `"docs/specs/"` | OPTIONAL directory where the spec track (/mango:brainstorm, /mango:spec) proposes to save briefs and specs (default docs/specs/). The user confirms each path before anything is written. |
| `spec_review` | Advanced | object | OPTIONAL. /mango:spec-review stops after max_rounds review rounds, converged or not (default 3). |
| `verification` | Advanced | object | OPTIONAL. How review measures the proving test on a working doc that declares PROTOCOL: v0.2. |
| `cause_taxonomy` | Advanced | array | The categories analysis classifies a bug's root cause against. |
